mode: read-only static training-path review plus CPU-only collapse guard behavioral tests

checked.item: Official signal/loss path remains imported from immutable integration; PVR ignores PRM scores; native BF16 transform and shared CPU baseline/norm are explicit.

Safe sync copies frozen base to FP32 CPU, adds detached LoRA delta, casts copy to base dtype, loads vLLM; never merges live actor. Live adapter hash and frozen parameter versions checked before/after.
Default LoRA only, no DoRA/lora_bias/lora_variant; optimizer contains only requires_grad tensors. Frozen base gradients forbidden.
Exactly 32 official micro losses, each scaled 1/32; finite gradients then max-norm1 clipping and one AdamW step. Sealed signal assertions protect against altered advantages or repeated normalization.
Reference forward disables adapter, retaining unchanged base; current-policy old logps are freshly collected each batch.

Fresh model/PRM initialization occurs before loading resumed LoRA, avoiding inherited initial-adapter assertions. Checkpoint hashes, optimizer steps, token counts, RNG, base hash and release hash are checked on resume.
Checkpoint committed via partial directory rename, then latest receipt; failed/interrupted stage is not silently replayed. Prior completed batch files cause an explicit stop.
Stop guard operates at fixed common stages and requires same threshold to persist in both adjacent five-batch windows. Parsed short correct or incorrect answers do not count as unparsed.

cpu_guard_test_cases: all short correct outputs remain allowed
short parsed wrong outputs remain allowed
empty exactly25percent in both windows triggers
one window below25percent does not trigger
both windows below25percent do not trigger
nonempty short-unparsed exactly50percent in both windows triggers
different single-window failure types do not fake persistence
real EOS excluded from short length, truncation not excluded
only last ten adjacent batches read without mutation
before ten batches no stop or file access
limits: No remote task, model or GPU was started by this reviewer.
Static checks do not certify real checkpoint reload, optimizer behavior or vLLM weight sync until runtime receipts exist.
Readback confirms selected packed vLLM weights; it does not prove merged BF16 vLLM and unmerged LoRA log probabilities are bitwise identical.
Crash recovery from failed stages remains deliberately manual; atomic checkpoint metadata is not a guarantee against filesystem failure.
The guard checks only preregistered stage endpoints, not arbitrary intermediate batches.
Validation on64 fixed held-out policy questions is descriptive, with PRM800K overlap already disclosed; no accuracy claim follows from these tests.
